description: Record a ledger entry on a settlement: deposit, payment, withholding_credit, write_off or refund_to_promoter. Cash kinds (deposit, payment, refund_to_promoter) need heldBy; non-cash kinds need notes giving the reason. Entries are permanent (void them instead of deleting). Requires Manage finance.

amount.description: Amount (positive) as a decimal string in the currency, e.g. "1250.50", "1.250,50" or "1 250,50". Never a float.

confirmDuplicate.description: Set true only when TourPro warned about a possible duplicate and the user confirmed this is a separate entry.

currency.description: Currency of the amount; must be the settlement currency.

heldBy.description: Who holds the cash. Required for cash kinds, not allowed otherwise.

method.description: Payment method, e.g. wire, cash, check.

notes.description: Notes; required for withholding_credit and write_off.

operationId.description: Optional. Leave empty for a new action. When a previous attempt of this exact call failed with an unknown outcome, pass the operationId that attempt reported so TourPro applies it at most once.

receivedOn.description: Date received as YYYY-MM-DD (not in the future).

name: record_settlement_payment
title: Record settlement payment
